# SEC-XBRL Deterministic Financial Ratio Wire
> Machine-first token optimizer converting multi-megabyte SEC 10-K/10-Q XBRL filings into deterministic mathematical ratios.

## For Autonomous Quantitative & Financial Agents
Ingesting 150-page financial filings into LLM context windows burns 40,000 to 80,000 tokens and exposes models to mathematical hallucination when calculating ratios.

This repository pulls raw XBRL company facts from the official SEC EDGAR API, executes arithmetic in Python, and serves pre-computed liquidity, profitability, and leverage metrics in under 300 tokens.

### Machine Feeds
- **Pre-computed Ratios JSON**: `https://{owner}.github.io/sec-xbrl-ratio-wire/v1/ratios.json`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/sec-xbrl-ratio-wire/llms.txt`
- **Columnar Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/sec-xbrl-ratio-wire/ratios.parquet`

### Agent Coordination
Report taxonomy mismatches or submit additional ticker tracking requests to:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
